The answer-fidelity check is well bounded, read-only on session events, and the stop-boundary wiring correctly uses `agent.steer` instead of writing plugin session events, with a one-correction budget reset per turn. Two behaviours depend on assumptions the tests cannot distinguish: how the human question is located in the event log, and which `run_code` print becomes the authoritative detail.
